vtr-pon.scope: Main application, helpers, test executables and build scripts; bundled self-authored test-pattern media separately CC0.

qtbase.scope: Core, Gui, Widgets, Network, DBus and selected Cocoa/image/TLS plugins; embedded notices follow the reviewed SBOM/source/feature conditions.

qtimageformats.scope: Only TIFF and WebP plugins; their separately linked libraries are separate components.

qtsvg.scope: Svg framework, SVG image and icon plugins; includes XSVG notice.

qtwebengine.scope: Only QtPdf; PDFium and its embedded third-party code also apply. QtWebEngine browser modules are not bundled.

gstreamer.scope: Selected libraries/plugins and scanner only. The build recipe also builds GPL plugins, but they are excluded from this .app.

gst-libav.scope: Rebuilt against the isolated LGPL FFmpeg; do not substitute Homebrew libav or FFmpeg.

gst-plugins-rs.scope: dav1d plugin, version 0.15.0-RELEASE; Rust dependency notices also apply.

ffmpeg.scope: 8.1 shared decoder build, GPL/nonfree/version3/autodetection disabled; embedded permissive-code notices retained.

dbus.scope: Select the AFL-2.1 alternative for libdbus, retain upstream notices.

flac.scope: Only libFLAC; command-line programs are not bundled.

freetype.scope: Select the FreeType License; retain embedded-code notices.

gettext.scope: Only libintl; GNU gettext programs under GPL are not bundled.

graphite2.scope: Select LGPL alternative; preserve original COPYING and header notices.

icu4c@78.scope: ICU 78.3 original license and data notices.

jpeg-turbo.scope: Only libjpeg; upstream license describes each part.

libvpx.scope: Include PATENTS and additional patent grant text as applicable.

libx11.scope: X11-style notices differ by source file; original COPYING retained.

mpg123.scope: Only libmpg123 decoder; retain original notice and license.

openssl@3.scope: Include NOTICE and Apache 2.0 original text.

opus.scope: Retain included third-party notices and patent grants.

orc.scope: Original notices cover differently licensed source fragments.

pcre2.scope: Retain additional upstream notices, including historical contributions.

xz.scope: Only liblzma; source package has other licenses for tools/tests.

zstd.scope: Select the BSD alternative for shared libzstd.

sourceDistribution: Same-download source sidecar; public hosting not yet configured

excludedQtAttributions.android-native-style: Android platform plugin is not bundled
excludedQtAttributions.android-gradle-wrapper: Android packaging tool is not bundled
excludedQtAttributions.wintab: Windows platform plugin is not bundled
excludedQtAttributions.pixman: Gui CMake explicitly excludes Pixman assembly for arm64; separate Qt NEON helpers remain enabled.
